rows.text: April 10, 2008
The Monetary Policy Committee of the Bank of Korea decided today to maintain the Base Rate at its current level (5.00%) for the intermeeting period.
The Monetary Policy Committee of the Bank of Korea decided today to maintain the Base Rate at its current level (5.00%) for the intermeeting period.
The Bank of Korea
Monetary Policy Decision
Domestic economy is exhibiting some signs of adjustment in its pace of expansion.
The Monetary Policy Committee of the Bank of Korea decided today to maintain the Base Rate at its current level (5.00%) for the intermeeting period.
While exports continue to post robust growth, domestic demand has moderated somewhat.
There still remains a high degree of uncertainty surrounding future economic developments, largely due to the international financial market turmoil and the US economic slowdown.
(The following is an English translation of the Monetary Policy Committee statement.)
The Monetary Policy Committee of the Bank of Korea decided today to maintain the Base Rate at its current level (5.00%) for the intermeeting period.
Consumer price inflation continues to show a rapid rise, mainly influenced by high oil prices.
Real estate prices have shown a rebound in certain areas.
Domestic economy is exhibiting some signs of adjustment in its pace of expansion.
While exports continue to post robust growth, domestic demand has moderated somewhat.
Liquidity is still ample in the financial markets and financial institutions' lending continues to show a steady increase.
There still remains a high degree of uncertainty surrounding future economic developments, largely due to the international financial market turmoil and the US economic slowdown.
Meanwhile, financial market price variables have been increasingly volatile, largely in response to the international financial market unrest.
